title: Semantic Reasoning Interface Wiring Trace
scope: semantic ownership coverage and audit scripts
AST ADT -> semantic dataflow authority -> generic DataFlowInterface -> SDK/React/CLI consumers
Laravel source example and frontend target presence

results.name: primary-key reconciliation consumes canonical schema relation index
results.detail: Primary-key reconciliation consumes the schema relation contract instead of searching raw SchemaInterface tables and columns again.

results.name: schema table/primary-column selection has one producer
results.detail: The existing schema relation index remains the sole table/primary-column selection boundary; no second schema classifier was added.

results.name: model builder constructs schema index once before reconciliation
results.detail: The canonical schema relation index is shared by primary-key reconciliation and model-relation construction.

results.name: primary-key status is a closed explicit judgment
results.detail: The reconciliation result preserves all four status outcomes without duplicating table/column classification.

results.name: primary-key reconciler no longer uses find/filter over raw schema
results.detail: Raw schema table lookup and primary-column filtering are no longer repeated inside the reconciliation judgment.

results.name: primary-key regression cases use canonical schema index
results.detail: Matched, conflict, unresolved, and composite-key ambiguity cases enter through the canonical schema relation index.

results.name: operation identity runtime algebra is adopted by authority
results.detail: Operation identity construction is centralized in the upstream algebra and delegated to by its authority.

results.name: operation identity wiring projects closed upstream capability
results.detail: The CLI emitter consumes the capability through an explicit projection instead of reconstructing operation identity.

results.name: operation identity contract carries semantic reasoning proof
results.detail: The exact upstream reasoning proof is preserved by the operation identity algebra.

results.name: AST dataflow interface aliases canonical semantic ADTs
results.detail: AST-facing dataflow is a typed boundary over the canonical semantic input/judgment, not a parallel solver model.

results.name: dataflow authority owns closure and reachability
dataflow wiring preserves proof and avoids reclassification
results.detail: The read-only DataFlowAuthorityInterface preserves the exact proof without advertising fake producer execution.

results.name: generic dataflow separates producer execution from consumer authority
results.detail: Execution and read-only authority are separate contracts.

results.name: SDK consumes operation identity fail-closed
results.detail: The SDK requires the upstream operation identity reference instead of deriving it from method/path.

results.name: React hook boundary consumes closed hook capability
results.detail: React hook selection uses the endpoint contract at the consumer boundary.

results.name: semantic ownership coverage audit remains present
results.detail: The existing semantic ownership audit remains the broad cross-layer guardrail.

results.name: Laravel source and generated Next.js frontend remain in the trace scope
results.detail: The source ecosystem, Laravel model/routes, and example frontend are present for source-to-target tracing.

results.name: React SDK and CLI production source remain in the trace scope
results.detail: The three downstream layers are checked at their active production entry points.

results.name: audit is registered without changing package version/build command
results.detail: The phase audit is reproducible; package version and build command remain unchanged.

decisions.decision: Consume the existing SchemaRelationIndexInterface and reuse the same index in the model builder.
decisions.reason: The raw-schema table lookup and primary-column filter were duplicated semantic selection inside the reconciliation judgment.

decisions.decision: Keep SemanticDataflowInput/Judgment as canonical ADTs and DataFlowInterface as a generic wiring/execution boundary.
decisions.reason: CodeQL likewise distinguishes AST nodes from data-flow graph nodes; semantic dataflow must not be silently equated with syntax-tree structure.

decisions.decision: Preserve the upstream capability/algebra/proof chain and project only a runtime-safe reference downstream.
decisions.reason: SDK/CLI consumers should not re-resolve identity from HTTP method/path.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing semantic ownership audit and add a focused wiring audit; do not fabricate consumers for declaration-only contracts.
decisions.reason: A static symbol declaration is not evidence of production adoption; ownership should be traced through producer, authority, wiring, and consumer.
